sql: SELECT y.trip_date, AVG(y.avg_trip_distance) AS avg_dist, AVG(y.avg_total_amount) AS avg_amount FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE d.d_dow = 6 AND y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' GROUP BY y.trip_date ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
